raw.name: Passkey Nightmare
raw.description:
Mattermark added passkeys to protect its flag. It only accepts direct
attestation from authenticators signed by a private certification
authority, so creating your own credential should be impossible.

The frontend source code is attached. Find a way to become trusted and
register a passkey that the service will accept.

> [!CONNECTION]
> https://passkey-nightmare-yfkirzul.challenge.2026.haruulzangi.mn
raw.author: flame
